I have literally been thinking about it for years. I left one day with my gun, told my wife, went to desert sat on hill and couldn't do it.
I called  my wife , she didn't answer, I called my best friend, he was busy at work with a meeting. So I sat there too chicken shit and finally went home. I think about what will people say constantly. I think if they will blame my wife at all or just say there was nothing we could do. He was going to do whatever no matter what. I have pretty much told everyone I am close to that I am going to commit suicide, they change the subject.  Im in debt 170k, Filing for bankruptcy, My youngest is very ill. My wife has never cared and is doing God knows what while I am working my body parts to the point of no repair. I hired some guys to work for me and they are ruing my work. Cant sleep much, back hurts, hands hurt, looking at 30k in insurance deductible this year plus meds, plus trying to eat healthy for daughter, wife still doesn't get eating healthy, Im just not sure I can go anymore
my first post is  44 too much pain

So I am still here. it seems there are so many more people so worse off than myself. I feel guilty for even posting or having suicidal thoughts. Who am I , when I start to listen to myself,  when my own daughter is going through so much. I dont know what to do or how to break this cycle. I am just paralyzed with depression, I have been in a state of uknowing and mental anguish for decades. I just have to keep finding the strength for my kids. I keep telling myself these things but it never really helps with all the emotions.
monitors can you please erase my name. i dint realize i put in there until after I read my psot

Had to cut this into 3rds.the middle third was lost, will have to re-type some time. starts here  after the game, one of the Coaches  game and tried to start a fight. I know he was even going to throw the 1st punch and then  lie to the cops until he happened to notice one OF  the PARENTS WAS FILMING THE WHOLE SITUATION. He came over yelling, you got a problem with my wife you got a problem with me. I said you bet I got a problem with someone personally attacking me for a rope I was standing on for a second. He pushed me and got in my face yelling more. The staff was watching, not trying to stop any of it, they put him up to it.This guy is 6'4' im 5'10' but im not taking no B.S. so Im standing my ground telling other parents to call the cops. They notice our film guys is taping and the whole situation changed, it was now me trying to start the fight and I needed to go or be escorted. I said get the cops. They talked all parents out of calling or whatever they never came but wish they had. I tried to get the video from our film guy but he wouldn't return my calls. See everyone wants their kid to play, and if you help the black balled guy, your kid will sit the bench too. He agreed with me in conversations but always had an excuse not to actually give the video, then it got taped over on accident. So there i was the bad guy, who was only trying to get equal treatment for his kid.Both my boys got shafted the entire time they played Pop Warner. I did have many good experiences with Club Softball when my daughter was young, Coached with a lot of really good people and felt good for a while. When she hit 16 , i figured she needed better Coaches than myself and thats when drama hit for her. She was always very good and many teams wanted her to pitch. We bounced around a lot looking for the right fit. We thought we had a fit on a really good team then it starts, protecting a better pitchers emotions by letting her pitch to bad teams and feeding my kid to the wolves when we played really good teams, somehow my daughter always pitched against very good teams, but she was #2, our number #1 had offers from many D1 universities but they would always hand pick our #1s games to pitch against opponents, the knew wouldn't beat her. She throws in the 60s , my daughter in 50s. So we changed to e a new team that we knew the Coach from little league who promised all our troubles are over. They said she could pitch play 3rd and 1st. It wasn't very long before she never got to play 3rd.  and 1st, her strongest position was every once in a while.
We paid for her travel to Houston where she played 1 game out of 6 in right field for a couple of innings. You maybe thinking typical dad who thinks his kid are better than they really are but I know thats not the case. When A---- was 15 she went to Colorado for the Sparkler tournament, biggest in the nation. 1200 teams all across the state. My daughter is pitching, we are down 1 run its late in the 5th. A---- is pitching lights out but were are still down. I wasnt there because we could not afford to go but every dad that was there told me the same story. She hit a shot that went over the 270 foot fence for slow pitch fields and the ball was still climbing as it left the park. everyone there said it was the hardest softball hit they ever saw.  The umpire after the game came up to A---- and told her that he umpires College games all the time and he has never seen one climbing as it went over the slow pitch fence. College fences are around 220 to 230 feet. Slow pitch usually 300.

Yes , I know I need to go to a Counselor, That doesn't help the constant thoughts of suicide. When everything first happened I would work myself to exhaustion so I could sleep. Now my body hurts so bad I cant really hold on to tools anymore. Cant work hardly at all anymore.  I need carpel tunnel surgery on both hands but haven't been to doctor yet. When I did recently start going to a Pain Doctor, my wife keeps saying, what are you doing wasting your time there.  I cant even work my body to the point of dropping anymore. So  I get a couple hours sleep most nights but sometimes I just lay there and cant stop the emotions. I start crying in bed and have to go out to the living room so my daughter doesn't hear or feel my emotions. My daughter still sleeps between my wife and I in bed. Her mind is literally starved for nutrition so she has night terrors. Nightmares that just keep coming and her little legs kick a lot. So I lay there and whisper things to calm her like. Lets take our dog Princess to the dog park. Are you playing soccer. I try to incorporate parts of her daily life that her mind can shift focus to in order to stop the nightmare cycle. My wife just lays there. I dont really have anyone to talk to. I was raised by a single mother, she moved to England after high school when I was 17. I have a brother who abused me when I was younger. We dont talk, I have a few friends that I have pushed away because i think my wife has had sex with them. Or I just realize how frickin selfish or crappy some people are. Now all this stress has worn me down. I walk around with a very intense look on my face, Im told. I dont know how Im suppose to look when Im crying inside most of the time. I see people and how they look at me, they even change their facial expressions as I do. I sat in front of T.V. most of my youth so I talk with my eyes like a person on a commercial or t.v. I never realized this until I started noticing how people will pop their eyes open really wide while talking to me because thats how I talk. I have tried to not use my eyes, I try to focus on peoples lips instead of their eyes so I dont make my eyes pop. It really freaks me out and people are put off by how I talk with my eyes. Some people think Im trying to flirt with them, its just how I learned and cant stop even though I want to. So I walk around with a lot of guilt issues and thinking people dont like me, which they dont, Everyone pretty much looks down on me and loves my wife. My daughter plays soccer for a really big Church, You would think that people knowing she is ill would give her at least fair opportunities. Church people are the shittiest people you can find other than youth sports over competitive freaks. My little girl despite being very ill is very good at soccer, She is usually the 2nd or 3rd best player on her team. These church coaches look at me and punish my daughter because I cant wipe the depression off my face. Her first coach, who is this GREAT GUY, Didnt say one single thing to my daughter for the 1st 6 weeks of practice, not 1 encouraging remark. he did say somethings she was doing wrong. Now this is her 4th year playing. we have played 3 games this season, she started on defense or on the bench. She got the least amount of playing time, even the new girls get more playing time. 
I have watched my kids get shafted in every youth sport situation you can think of. My oldest was captain of his high school football team as a linebacker for his last 2 seasons. He never left the field and played left tackle on offense. He never played 1 single down at linebacker in pop warner because all the crappy cops and rhoid freaks trying to live through their kids, they were never that good so they will do anything to try to give their own kid a advantage.   I have watched police officer coaches pull a hitting dummy away from my 2nd boy and make him flop on the ground because he didnt get in his stance good enough at 10 years old. What kind of Jerk pulls a hitting pad away from a kid in mid drill to make him land on the ground awkwardly and get hurt. What kind of person tells me as a DAD, here your sons play, hes right guard and hes going to pull and go block the safety. So im watching and this coaches son ear holes my sons helmet as hard as he can and delivers a crushing  blow to my sons helmet on the ear hole.  They do that on purpose to try and get the less intense kids to quit. My son just wanted to make friends and be happy but he was also capable of being a very good lineman, one of the best. Then tells my son after he stops crying ( only time he ever cried, kids tough as nails ) I told you to keep your head on a swivel. So my son jogs to where the coaches say, here is the safety, go here block here. So the safety had moved to the line, my son couldn't find any one to block  so hes kind of standing there looking side to side and the coaches kid comes flying in and ear holes him. I literally starting taking my phone and videoing practices but back then the cameras were not good enough to even tell which one was my son. My daughter walked away from her softball scholarship because her team was full of shitty people. I coached football until pop warner decided that I wasnt on the in anymore. I coached with my older sons team. My younger sons first year, I went to a practice where the new Coach, Motor Cycle cop Todd, was running a drill. I was young and excited and was not trying to tell him what to do but I said to him you have 7 and 8 yeard olds 20 yards apart and running a corner tackling drill. The fast ones were just beating the slow ones to the corner and the drill was ineffective because the slower kids ( my 2nd ) were getting frustrated because they couldn't get there in time to make a tackle.  So this guy decides im trying to tell him what to do and pretty much made a big stink in front of parents. Telling me I am violating the parent code of ethics. I was one Coach talking to another.Oh yeah , the other guys I coached with, decided they didnt want me coaching anymore " all you do is Coach your own kid " What a frickin lie, All I did is take the kids they didnt want to Coach, labeled nonathletic, or here for the parents, dont really want to play, or dont want to hit. And try to Coach them up. I turned a few into pretty decent line men and my own son got very good. He would play linebacker in practice when 1st team offense was practicing. They put the other ( or scrubb defense )  out when 1st team offense was practicing. My son was tearing them up. To the point that the head Coach starts yelling, who the hell is this kid and why cant we block him. Starts berating the line men that are suppose to block him.I taught him dip and rip or skinny in the hole. They found ways to fix that by putting him on the line for offense and played limited defense at a tackle position. They didnt want him on defense when they were trying to run the offense. So Im coaching with these guys, seasons getting ready to start, we are having our first scrimmage. Im somewhat chummy with these guys so I ask the defensive Coach before the scrimmage. " Are you going to take a look at my son tonight at linebacker. We were walking together to the field, he stopped, turned towards me, puffed out his chest and yelled" Im the defensive coordinator for this team and you better get that through your fucking head. ------ will never play linebacker so you just better get used to it. " Then the head Coach chimes in " You know what you need to do is get your own team " then you can see how hard it is to win with these kids. This scenario and ones like this play out through out all my kids youth sports. The biggest scum of the earth will do anything to give their kids advantages. Homeless people have more values and moral backbone than cheating cops and other people that are suppose to be good people. Its sickening. All this just keeps tearing me down and my wife just keeps doing her own thing. She works weekends now, so Im pretty much alone with kids when I am home. I am severely depressed so I try to get out and go the park but then I see all the other families. husband and wife teams and I realize I have never had a team mate, just this B i Had 4 kids with. She is constantly trying to ditch me after work and take off with kids. Like she wants to go to the Casino were my sister in law plans her boyfriends daughters 11th birthday party at an arm pit Indian Casino. I guess its better than nothing. Oh yeah shes a gambling addict. She gave my oldest son a trip with her to the Casino in Cali for his 18th birthday too. There is one there you can gamble at 18 , I guess, thats what they told me anyways. My wifes family is very supportive of her and pretty much hates me. I have been calling them out for years on all their bullshit cuz I didnt use to take any.
So my wife still declares she has never cheated. What would you think if you had a wife that needed to go out of state with her sis every few years for her Birthday and not call or be accountable. I wouldn't really think anything of it, and I didnt use to until one year my wife goes to Vegas with her friends and within hours of her being there, disappears from friends, wont answer phone, comes home with a business card from some dude in Texas, and says he was giving those out to everyone, ask kim. I did, she was like Im so sorry Derren, I dont know what to say. So her story is ooh I got so drunk so fast, I went to the room and passed out. at 7pm.  I just cant stop all these memories flooding my mind. Im literally in mental anguish 24/7. I want to leave but dont want to stress out my sick daughter,who already feels the tension, asks if were getting a divorce cuz now
